text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging sara (oncall) — elevated 5xx rate from canary pool in us-west-2. Service: router-service. Error spike started at 1795002096. Please ack and triage.

sara (oncall): Acked. I'm looking now. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy started by olivia: router-service:v2.1.3 -> canary 5% @ 1795002078

olivia (prod-eng): Yep pushed a canary for header-routing change and diag logging. No config map changes besides a small env ref.

lee (sre): Logs show CrashLoopBackOff on canary pods. Sample: 
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=router-service -o wide
router-service-canary-5df7b   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   5 (2m ago)   23s
```
And container logs show: 
```
Error: failed to initialize key provider: secret "kms-router-key" not found
panic: missing secret
```
So seems init failure.

jamal (platform): Why didn't the secret mount? That secret was in KMS project A, canary uses nodeSelector -> dedicated-canary-nodes which don't have the same KMS role. Could be RBAC/mounting issue.

sara (oncall): If initContainers fail readiness, the HPA might later scale down. What are HPA min/max?

lee (sre): HPA config shows minReplicas: 0 (wrong), maxReplicas: 10, targetCPUUtilization: 50.

olivia (prod-eng): Wait, our rollout recipe assumed minReplicas: 1 for canaries. The deployment manifest in the release branch accidentally set minReplicas to 0 when templating. I pushed that in this release.

jamal (platform): Ah — race condition: init fails -> pods not ready -> metrics server (custom) returns 0 -> HPA interprets as no demand and scales to 0 because minReplicas=0 -> no pods -> traffic to canary returns 5xx -> alert.

mary (cs): We already have 3 customers pinging support about failures in us-west-2 routing. Need status for customers.

sara (oncall): Ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) Flip feature flag traffic off to stop sending new users to canary; 2) Manually scale deployment to 1 replica; 3) Revert HPA minReplicas to 1 in canary and apply; 4) Re-run deploy with corrected secret mount / RBAC or revert image.

olivia (prod-eng): I can toggle the FF now. Flag key: `router_canary_rollout`. Setting to `false`.

olivia (prod-eng): Done. `router_canary_rollout=false` — traffic should stop flowing to canary. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: :information_source: Traffic shift complete. Observed traffic to canary pool dropped to 0% at 1795002195.

jamal (platform): While traffic is stopped, I'll scale the deployment so we have a stable pod to debug.

jamal (platform): Running:
```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/router-service --replicas=1 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/router-service
```

jamal (platform): `kubectl apply -f` with corrected HPA patch:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: router-service-hpa
spec:
  minReplicas: 1
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
```
Applied HPA patch at 1795002270.

lee (sre): Scaling up shows pod starting but still failing init due to secret. Need to check secret presence in canary namespace/labels. `kubectl get secret kms-router-key -n prod` returns NotFound.

jamal (platform): That secret is provided via our secrets-sync job for dedicated nodes. The job failed earlier during a maintenance window and didn't sync to canary nodes group. I'll re-run sync and check RBAC mapping.

jamal (platform): Re-ran sync job: `jobs/secrets-sync` — logs show `synced secret kms-router-key to nodepool dedicated-canary` at 1795002322.

lee (sre): Pod logs now show service starting, liveness/readiness proceed. Deployment `router-service` now ready.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary readiness back at 100% (1/1) at 1795002340.

mary (cs): Messaging: telling impacted customers we rolled back canary routing and restored baseline. Draft: "We briefly routed a subset of traffic to a canary which experienced an initialization error; we disabled the canary and restored normal routing. No data loss; further updates to follow." Approve?

olivia (prod-eng): Approve. We'll also revert the release template that set minReplicas to 0 and open PR.

sara (oncall): Postmortem checklist: - Root cause: release templating bug set HPA minReplicas=0 + missing secret sync to canary nodepool. - Mitigations: 1) Add CI lint rule preventing minReplicas <1 for router-service, 2) Add pre-deploy check to validate all required secrets exist in target nodepools, 3) Make feature flag toggles auto-revert if error rate >1% for 5m, 4) Incident runbook update to include HPA sanity checks.

jamal (platform): I'll open the PRs for the hpa-lint and secret precheck. Also will change our secrets-sync to alert on failures rather than silent retry.

olivia (prod-eng): I'll revert the canary manifest change and cut a hotfix rollback image.

sara (oncall): Final state: traffic to canary disabled, baseline routing healthy, no active customer-impacting errors as of 1795002430. Leaving incident open for postmortem and follow-up action items.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated — monitoring. Assigned owners: jamal (platform) for secrets & HPA fix, olivia (prod-eng) for release process, lee (sre) for runbook updates.

mary (cs): Notifying customers that service is restored.

sara (oncall): Handoff to jamal for follow-ups. I'm ending rotation at 1795002525. Jamal, you're oncall for postmortem.

jamal (platform): Taking it. Thanks.

incident-bot: :calendar: Incident created: 1795002100. Severity: P2.
